description_en: This Sattaḥ is located at the southern edge of Cvachẽ Square, between Cyāsal to the east and Bhelāchẽ to the west. It thus lies south of Gaṇeśa Phalcā (LAL4143), southwest of Saṃkha Bāhā, and southeast of Cidhaṃgu Phalcā. There is acaityaanddharmadhātu maṇḍalain front of the Phalcā in the small courtyard. The courtyard also has two morephalcā, one of which was destroyed by the 2015 earthquake. The three-storey building consists of a five-bay Phalcā in the ground floor and two upper floors. These upper floors are now residential homes and have been privately occupied for ca. 40 years. The building is positioned on the elevated ground floor of the adjunct building of Śaṃkhadhara Bahāl (LAL1700). The building adjacent to the Phalcā is now private property. According to the law, the house owner must leave the Phalcā section open. S/he may not change or close thedalānoff with a window or a wall.
description_ne: यो सत्तः पूर्वपट्टि च्यासल र पश्चिमपट्टि भेलाछेँको बीचमा च्वछेँ चौबाटोको दक्षिणी किनारमा रहेको छ । यो सत्तः गणेश फल्चाको दक्षिण,शङ्ख बाहाको दक्षिणपश्चिम र चिधंगु फल्चाको दक्षिणपूर्वतर्फ रहेको छ । त्यस फल्चाको अगाडि एउटा चैत्य र एउटा धर्मधातुमण्डल छ,अनि यो सानो चोकमा अरू दुई फल्चा छन् जसमध्ये एउटा फल्चा २०७३ सालको भूकम्पमा ध्वस्त भएको थियो । तीन तला भएको सत्तःको भवनमा भुइँ तलामा एउटा पाँच कवल भएको फल्चा छ,माथिका दुई तला व्यक्तिगत वसोवासको लागि प्रयोग भएको लगभग चालीस वर्ष भैसक्यो ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)

historical_events.event_description: Donation by Śaṅkha Dhar Avāḥ. A stone inscription is available on the wall of the main monastic building.
